summary: Expanded terminal-first operator visibility for ecosystem state while keeping agentd read-only and outside resolver or activation authority.
acceptance_evidence: OperatorProjection ecosystem section remains read_only through the parent projection source agentd-read-only.
Projection reads durable registry, staging root, lockfile path and active-set path as status data only.
Projection exposes registry_snapshot_digest, registry_artifact_count, core_artifacts, staged_artifact_count, active_artifact_count and pending_activation_count.
Projection keeps activation_status=gated and activation_authority=AgentCore PlanSpec + SecurityExecutionEngine.
Projection reports required_approvals including exact approval token for ecosystem.activate.
Projection reports blocked_until including local replay evidence, compatibility evidence, exact approval token, rollback handle and audit journal seal.
Projection reports blocked_reasons explaining that install/stage are inert until an approved activation PlanSpec.
TUI render_operator_projection surfaces ecosystem registry, activation_status, required_approvals and blocked_until.
operator-commands.json updates aom.activate to AgentCore PlanSpec activation preview and removes old task-ID blockers.
